title: What Made The CMF By Nothing Phones So Much Cheaper? - BGR
summary: Its two CMF phones to date — the CMF Phone 1 and the positively reviewed CMF Phone 2 Pro — didn't get a full release in the U.S., with CMF instead prioritizing the U.K., select EU countries, and various markets in Asia.
